S2 ERROR — `if (activeOutput.error)` entry:260. **NEVER FIRES.** The server's error builder emits `errorDetail`, never `error` (x402-core dist `G()`). Would have rendered `EmptyMessage` with a danger Warning icon + `activeOutput.error` as title + "Dexter could not build the marketplace view for this request." Backend failures fall through to S3 instead.

S3 EMPTY — `if (activeOutput.count === 0)` entry:272. Three copy variants keyed off `noMatchReason`:
   • `noMatchReason === 'below_strong_threshold'` → title `Only weak matches for "<q>"`, desc "We found some adjacent services but nothing cleared the strong-match bar. Try a more specific verb for the capability you want."

   • null/anything else (INCLUDING every backend error) → same title, desc "Try a broader query or a different angle."

DRAWER'S SECOND PAYLOAD — `GET https://api.dexter.cash/api/x402/resource?url=…&history=3&full_previews=1` (drawer:70). Verified live:

The drawer already pays for this request and ignores nearly all of it — including the resource-level verifier notes that would fix the row's dead Professor.

DROPPED: duration_ms, paid, payment_network, payment_tx_signature, probe_status, probe_error, response_content_type, response_preview, ai_model, skip_reason, initiator, test_input_generated, test_input_reasoning, chains_evaluated, ai_tokens_used. `response_preview` in particular — `full_previews=1` is explicitly requested and then never shown.

CURRENT LOOK — three incompatible visual languages stacked in one widget:
  (a) The `.dx-search-*` sheet — slate-navy translucent surfaces, 22px radii, mono microtype (9-11px, uppercase, letter-spacing .14–.28em), amber-orange accent, `color-mix()` accent tints everywhere. Coherent on its own.
  (b) Raw Tailwind utilities in the ENTRY — hardcoded hex/rgba that bypass the tokens entirely: `text-[#ff9a52]` (entry:330, 380 in row-adjacent code), `border-[rgba(255,107,0,0.18)]` (entry:334), `border-white/8` (entry:359), `rounded-2xl`/`rounded-[22px]`, `border-subtle`/`bg-surface`/`text-tertiary` (apps-sdk-ui classes). Note #ff6b00/#ff9a52 in the utility layer vs `--dx-accent: #ff7a1a` in the token layer — THREE different oranges in one widget, none of which is the wallet's ember.
  (c) `dx-pricing__*` (Professor/Doctor) — cartoon-adjacent: avatars, a thermometer, a rubber-stamp letter grade, speech bubbles with tails, word-by-word prose reveal animation. Imported wholesale from the pricing widget.
  (d) DebugPanel — pure inline styles, `rgba(0,0,0,.3)` panel, #facc15 yellow header, #60a5fa blue, #fb7185 red, 10px monospace. Zero relationship to anything else.

TYPOGRAPHY: no font-family declared anywhere in the search sheet except `--dx-font-mono` for microtype. Body copy inherits whatever the host iframe provides — so there is NO Inter/Inter Display and NO deliberate type scale. Sizes are a mix of tokens (`--dx-text-md`, `--dx-text-sm`) and hardcoded px (9, 10, 11, 12px) and Tailwind arbitrary values (`text-[10px]`, `text-[11px]`).

MONEY TYPOGRAPHY: `.dx-search-cell__fetch-price` gets `--dx-font-mono` at 12px/600 (x402-search.css:517) — the only money type in the widget. No `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums` anywhere. Prices arrive as pre-formatted strings and the row strips the `$` while the drawer keeps it.

MOTION: card entrance stagger 50+35n ms (row:81); `.dx-search-cell` transitions on opacity 200ms / transform 240ms `--dx-ease-emphasized` / border 160ms; loading rings pulse + logo rotates + orbit tick; Professor's word-by-word reveal (disabled here — `animate={false}` at row:162, drawer:296); mobile sheet `animate-[fadein_.18s_ease-out]`.

WHAT ALREADY MATCHES THE WALLET BAR (wallet.css `.dxw-root`: --page #F1EEE8, --paper #FFFDF9, --ink #1D1710/#6F6659/#A39784, --hair rgba(61,50,39,.10), --ember #F2681A, --gold #CBAD72, Inter + JetBrains Mono, 24px radius, layered soft shadows):

  • The `--selected` / `--featured` / hover triad is a sane three-step emphasis ladder; only the colors are wrong.

notes:
SCOPE OF THE REAL WORK. Only four components ship: MarketplaceSummaryHeader, SearchVerdictRow, SearchVerdictDrawer, MarketBoardLoading (+ SearchIdentityIcon, ChainIcon/UsdcIcon, X402gleLockup, DexterLoading, DebugPanel). Three files in the same directory are orphans and should be deleted before styling begins so nobody restyles a component that can never render: SearchResultCard.tsx, SearchResourceDetail.tsx, SearchScoreBadge.tsx.

THE PAYLOAD IS RICHER THAN THE UI. This is the biggest opportunity and the reason the widget currently feels thin. Already in hand per result and thrown away: `qualityScore` (the verifier's whole output), `why` (a written per-result justification from the ranker), `similarity`, `docsUrl`, `openapiSpecUrl`, `latencyP50Ms`/`latencyP95Ms`, `uptimePct`, and `chains[].priceLabel`/`priceUsdc`/`scheme`. The row today shows host, a verified tick, a call count, a truncated description, chain dots, and a price — while a written explanation of why this result matched and a 0-100 quality grade sit unused in the same object. The `why` string in particular is the single highest-value unrendered field: it is the answer to the only question a buyer has.

PER-CHAIN PRICES ARE ALREADY LOCAL. `chains[]` arrives with `priceLabel` per network (live-verified: `[{network:"eip155:8453", priceUsdc:0.01, priceLabel:"$0.01", scheme:"exact"}]`). The row renders the chain icons and drops the prices; the drawer then makes a network round-trip to api.dexter.cash to rebuild the same list under "Payment routes". A multi-chain price display in the row costs zero requests.

THE PROFESSOR/DOCTOR DECISION. These carry a different product's personality (avatars, thermometer, rubber stamp, speech bubbles) into a surface that is supposed to become calm paper. They are already dead in the row (B3) and only alive in the drawer. Two coherent paths: (1) drop them from search entirely, drop the x402-pricing.css import, and express the verifier verdict natively — score, status, notes as quiet typography; or (2) keep them only in the drawer and gate `ai_notes` the way the row does (B4). Path 1 removes 20.7KB of CSS and the last cross-widget style dependency.

THE HEADER IS THE LOUDEST THING ON SCREEN. `X402gleLockup` puts four saturated Google hues (#4285F4/#EA4335/#FBBC05/#34A853) at the top of the widget, above everything. On cream paper with an ember accent this will dominate. It is also a deliberate product decision — the docblock at MarketplaceSummaryHeader.tsx:4-11 explains that search is an x402gle product, not a bare-Dexter one, and that the bare Dexter wordmark was explicitly rejected. Treat the multi-color lockup as a constraint to design AROUND (scale it down, give it air, let the rest of the page be quiet), not one to quietly replace.

DUAL-RUNTIME IS HALF-DONE AND IT SHOWS. The entry's own comments (entry:69-72, 122-127) document that a ChatGPT-only snapshot reader once hung this widget forever on Claude, and that the READ path was migrated to the adapter to fix it. The WRITE path (`useCallToolFn`), `useToolInput`, and the three layout hooks were never migrated (B5, B6). On Claude today: both action buttons throw silently, the query never appears in loading or empty copy, and fullscreen + mobile layouts are unreachable. The correct hooks already exist and are already exported — this is a five-line import change, and it should land before or with the restyle, because otherwise half the states being designed can never be seen on the host they were designed for.

NO TYPE SAFETY NET. `npm run build:apps-sdk` never runs `tsc`; apps-sdk/tsconfig.json is not referenced by any script. That is how B2 survived. Whatever gets written next has the same absence of a net — the only feedback loop is `npm run deploy:mcp` (build + `pm2 restart dexter-mcp`) and looking at it.

WALLET REFERENCE FOR NAMESPACING. wallet.css scopes everything under `.dxw-root` with local custom properties (`--page/--paper/--ink/--hair/--ember/--gold`) and a `:where()` button reset so class-based backgrounds win without `!important` (wallet.css:22-28). The search sheet has no equivalent root scope — its `.dx-search-*` classes float in the global sheet alongside `.dx-pricing__*` and Tailwind utilities. Adopting a `.dxs-root` (or reusing the `dxw-` token block) is what makes the restyle survivable; otherwise entry-level Tailwind utilities like `text-[#ff9a52]` (entry:330) will keep leaking non-brand color into a themed component.

TESTING PATH. `x402_search` is live and callable: `curl "https://x402.dexter.cash/api/x402gle/capability?q=ETH%20price%20feed&limit=3"` returns the raw upstream shape, and `curl "https://api.dexter.cash/api/x402/resource?url=<encoded>&history=3&full_previews=1"` returns the drawer's payload. Both were used to verify every claim above. Deploy is `npm run deploy:mcp` from /home/branchmanager/websites/dexter-mcp (builds all widgets, then `pm2 restart dexter-mcp`).
